metadata.description: Critical stability settings for Blender soft body physics to prevent simulation failures

step_min.reason: Prevents jitter explosions by ensuring adequate simulation substeps
step_min.warning: Values below 10 can cause instability with complex meshes

step_max.reason: Enables adaptive stepping for large deformations
step_max.warning: Very high values (>200) may slow simulation without benefit

damping.reason: Prevents energy buildup that causes mesh explosion
damping.warning: Too high (>5) makes the simulation overly stiff

goal_spring.reason: Balance between shape retention and deformation

voxel_remesh.required_for: Joined primitives (objects created from multiple bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_* calls)
voxel_remesh.reason: Soft body requires manifold geometry with consistent vertex distribution
voxel_remesh.how: Apply Remesh modifier with mode='VOXEL', voxel_size=0.1-0.2

common_issues.cause: step_min too low, damping too low
common_issues.fix: Increase step_min to 20+, increase damping to 2.0+

common_issues.symptom: Mesh collapses or falls through collision objects
common_issues.cause: Insufficient collision quality or step settings
step_max too high, overly complex mesh
common_issues.fix: Reduce step_max, decimate mesh before simulation
Apply voxel remesh to create uniform mesh

rules: Always check mesh topology before applying soft body
Joined primitives MUST be voxel-remeshed for stable simulation
Use step_min >= 20 for any soft body simulation
Increase damping when seeing any oscillation or jitter
Test with simple mesh first before applying to complex geometry
warnings: Default step settings (5/10) are INSUFFICIENT for most use cases
bpy.ops.ptcache.bake_all() is unreliable in headless mode - use live_render pattern instead
Soft body simulation on joined primitives WITHOUT remesh will fail

evaluation_notes.warning: VFX evaluator may penalize clean mesh geometry - use mesh-specific metrics
